transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?
I've been feeling persistently depressed, sad, and down for a very long time now. It has been going on continuously for about two years and one month, and I just can't seem to shake this gloomy mood.
Have you ever had a period of at least two months during this time when your mood felt back to normal, or has it been depressed nearly every day without a break?

No, I haven't had any breaks like that at all. It has been a continuous, heavy sadness almost every single day for the entire two years and one month. I definitely haven't had a period of even two months where my mood felt back to normal.

That chronic course fits Persistent Depressive Disorder and makes Major Depressive Disorder less likely, since MDD is typically episodic rather than continuously present for this duration.
